thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Sev 2 - potential data exposure reported from private deployment connector. Incident created 1784507890. Please acknowledge and triage.
Elena: acked. I'm pulling the connector logs and the private deployment audit trail.
Raj: saw the alert—looks like an error while rotating a customer-specific S3 presign token. Might be a permissions mismatch.
Sam: :eyes: which customers affected? any PII?
Elena: initial query says 3 requests returned headers that included an authorization token for a different tenant. unclear if token was expired or leaked. No obvious object payloads in the logs yet.
Kevin: I'm looking at network proxy logs now. There's a short window 2026-03-15T08:11:xxZ where a routing rule misapplied tenant_id -> route map. Could be config rollout.
Elena: rolling back the routing change to the previous commit (revert rfc-bridge-112) to stop further cross-tenant routing. Doing canary rollback on edge now. ETA 2m.
Raj: good. Also toggling read-only mode on the connector for affected cluster to prevent writes.
Security: please capture evidence snapshot (logs + headers) and lock any credentials that might be in headers. I'm pulling the audit index now.
Elena: snapshot taken and uploaded to /internal/incidents/1784507890/evidence-1 (internal link).
Sam: is this customer-impacting? we should decide status page + customer notification ASAP.
Kevin: list of potentially touched tenants: tenant-alpha-prod, tenant-gamma-2, tenant-delta-staging. Need confirmation whether any object keys (S3) were returned.
Elena: quick grep shows object keys are not present in those responses — only auth headers leaked. That still counts as credential exposure.
Security: agree. Treat as credential exposure. We need scoped disclosure to customers whose tokens may have been exposed. Suggest initial timeline: 30m to confirm scope, 60m to send preliminary notice to impacted customers, and a public status page update if multiple tenants confirmed.
Raj: also starting a quick sweep to rotate any short-lived tokens we control and notify downstream services to refuse tokens issued during the window.
Legal: loop me in on the customer notification language. We'll need to include recommended actions and mention we are rotating keys on their behalf where applicable.
Elena: drafting a short customer notification. Pasting candidate text below for review: 
```
Subject: Important: Potential credential exposure for your Redwood Inference private deployment

Hi team,

We detected an issue in our routing logic that may have exposed short-lived authorization tokens associated with requests to your private deployment during a brief window on 2026-03-15. We are treating this as a potential credential exposure.

What we did so far:
- Identified and rolled back the routing change that caused cross-tenant headers to be returned.
- Disabled the affected connector in read-only mode and are rotating short-lived tokens issued during the window.
- Captured logs and evidence for investigation.

What you should do:
- Rotate any long-lived service credentials you manage (if any) as a precaution.
- Invalidate sessions if you see unexpected activity.
- Contact support@redwood.inference with any concerns; include your tenant id and timing.

We will follow up with a detailed incident report and any remediation steps as we learn more.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Trust & Security
```
Elena: thoughts?
Sam: overall OK, maybe call out the exact time window (08:11:05Z - 08:11:42Z) if we're confident. Also add: "We are rotating tokens we issued during the window on your behalf."
Security: add line about what we DO NOT believe was impacted (no object contents were returned). Important for customer calm.
Legal: add standard legal disclaimer and a contact alias for privacy enquiries (privacy@redwood.inference). Approve draft once those edits are in.
Kevin: I'll prepare the statuspage update. Draft below for ops/status page: 
```
Status: Partial service incident
Components: Private deployment connector (token routing)
Impact: Short-lived authorization headers may have been exposed across tenants for a limited time. No stored object contents observed.
Start: 2026-03-15 08:11:05 UTC
Current status: Mitigation in progress. Routing change rolled back; connector in read-only; token rotation underway.
Next update: in 60 minutes or sooner.
```
Raj: we should include an internal checklist for the incident channel: evidence capture, scope confirmation, token rotation logs, customer notify list, P0/P1 repair tasks, postmortem owner.
Elena: adding checklist now in-channel: 1) Confirm tenant list (Elena) 2) Evidence bundle (Raj) 3) Token rotation completed + log (Kevin) 4) Customer draft reviewed (Legal + Security) 5) Statuspage updated (Ops) 6) Postmortem assigned (TBD)
Elena: quick ask - @Security can you confirm whether privacy review required before customer notices?
Security: privacy review required if any headers contained PII (none seen so far). We still run privacy review in parallel; Legal can triage for regulatory disclosure obligations.
Legal: if any EU tenants are in the impacted list we'll need GDPR oriented wording; please flag specific tenants and we'll prepare language.
Sam: tenant-gamma-2 is in eu-west-1, flagging Legal.
Elena: noted.
Elena: preparing the impacted-customer list now; will DM Legal and Security once confirmed. ETA 12m.
Kevin: rotation script started. Will push results to /internal/incidents/1784507890/rotation-log when done. ETA ~20m.
Raj: captured curl examples and logs for engineers: 
```
# example of header returned during window (sanitized)
Authorization: Bearer <short-lived-token-sanitized>
Tenant-Id: tenant-alpha-prod
```
Elena: timeline update: rollback succeeded at 08:12:10Z, connector toggled to read-only at 08:12:30Z.
Security: good. Please keep evidence immutable. No further actions from security until postmortem signoff.
Elena: can someone own the customer notify send? I can draft but need an ops person to actually send from the customer-communications alias.
Sam: I can send once Legal and Security sign off.
Legal: I expect to review within 20 minutes after you DM the tenant list.
Elena: note for internal ops: don't mention 'credential exposure' in a public tweet; keep public statuspage wording higher level until customers are notified.
Sam: ack. Public post will be the status page text Kevin drafted.
Elena: rolling notes — will attach final customer list and final canned message here when ready.
(08:31) Elena: final impacted tenants confirmed: tenant-alpha-prod, tenant-gamma-2 (EU), tenant-delta-staging. DMed Legal + Security.
(Legal): reviewed and approved redacted customer notice; added GDPR paragraph for tenant-gamma-2.
(Sam): sending preliminary notices to the three tenants now. Will post copy and recipients once sent.
(Ops): status page updated with Kevin's draft and marked as "Mitigation in progress".
Kevin: rotation completed. Logs at /internal/incidents/1784507890/rotation-log. All short-lived tokens issued during window rotated or invalidated where possible.
Elena: outstanding: postmortem owner needed, runbook gaps: better pre-deploy checks for routing map updates.
Raj: I'll own the postmortem.
Elena: thanks. Closing note: good triage team response. We'll follow up with full postmortem and customer remediation summary in 48 hours.
Sam: +1. Closing this coordination thread — further discussion moved to #postmortems once writeup starts. :thumbsup:
